evidence.snippet: We also linked mutations in human Fritz to Bardet-Biedl and Meckel-Gruber syndromes, a notable link given that other genes mutated in these syndromes also influence collective cell movement and ciliogenesis.

nodes.description: WDPCP (Fritz) encodes a planar cell polarity effector and actin-associated scaffold that localizes to the ciliary transition zone, where it recruits septins (Sept2) and transition-zone proteins (Nphp1, Mks1) required for cilium assembly while interacting with Sept2 on cytoplasmic actin filaments. Biallelic WDPCP loss-of-function variants disrupt both transition-zone protein recruitment and septin-actin association.

evidence.reference_title: Wdpcp, a PCP protein required for ciliogenesis, regulates directional cell migration and cell polarity by direct modulation of the actin cytoskeleton.
evidence.snippet: We observed Wdpcp is localized to the transition zone, and in Wdpcp-deficient cells, Sept2, Nphp1, and Mks1 were lost from the transition zone, indicating Wdpcp is required for recruitment of proteins essential for ciliogenesis.

evidence.reference_title: Wdpcp, a PCP protein required for ciliogenesis, regulates directional cell migration and cell polarity by direct modulation of the actin cytoskeleton.
evidence.snippet: Wdpcp interacts with Sept2 and is colocalized with Sept2 in actin filaments, but in Wdpcp-deficient cells, Sept2 was lost from the actin cytoskeleton, suggesting Wdpcp is required for Sept2 recruitment to actin filaments.

evidence.reference_title: Planar cell polarity acts through septins to control collective cell movement and ciliogenesis.
